editionReview.cleanTitle: Il Taccuino di Luigi Galvani · facsimile
editionReview.reasoning: The original scan describes a bicentenary facsimile published in Bologna by Nicola Zanichelli and numbered 353 of 500. The Como institutional inventory and Seab catalogue identify the corresponding 1937 publication. The card itself says 1837; this is a catalogue date conflict, not just an OCR error. Treat 1937 as the proposed correction until the book is inspected. A contemporary 1937 UMI notice independently describes Zanichelli’s numbered edition of 500; the family date conflict remains.
editionReview.verificationScope: Probable 1937 Zanichelli notebook facsimile. No verified physical-copy census or current ownership count.
discrepancies: Family card:XXV, 68 leaves, 41 pages; Seab describesXXV, 68 leaves, 42 pages. The one-page difference needs inspection.
Any later reproduction must be distinguished from the 500-copy numbered issue.
